title: Detective Arcade
unlocks: investigation themes, badges and profile decorations

games.name: Red Flag or Green Flag?
games.how: Read the fictional situation and call it: red, beige or green flag.
games.teaches: Spot healthy and unhealthy patterns. Reflection only: never a label for a real person.

games.name: Excuse or Explanation?
games.how: Is this taking responsibility, or dodging it?
games.teaches: Accountability sounds like owning it and changing it. Excuses shift the blame.

games.name: Behaviour Decoder
games.how: What might this behaviour mean? Pick the most balanced reading.
games.teaches: There's usually more than one explanation. Look at patterns, not single moments.

games.name: Text Detective
games.how: Read the fictional text. What pattern is it?
games.teaches: Name communication patterns so you can respond, not react.

games.name: Spot the Red Flag
games.how: Which line in this fictional dating profile is the concern?
games.teaches: Read profiles for respect, not just looks.

games.name: Green Flag Pairs
games.how: Match each green-flag behaviour to what it shows.
games.teaches: Learn what healthy looks like, so you can spot it.

games.name: Compatibility Chat
games.how: Spin for a values question. Answer honestly, on your own or together.
games.teaches: Shared values matter more than shared hobbies.

games.name: Case Closed
games.how: Read the fictional case file and reach the fairest verdict.
games.teaches: Judge patterns over moments, and check your own assumptions.
